why: The conjecture itself remains open, but the closely watched proxy quantity (largest prime factor of n^2+1 exceeding n^c) was pushed from exponent 1.279 (Merikoski) to 1.3 (Pascadi, 2024) and a further arXiv preprint dated Sept 2025/2026 (arXiv:2609.01327) claims another improvement; unclear whether the deep-dive would count this proxy bound as moving 'this problem' as stated (infinitude of primes n^2+1) or as adjacent work on a different quantity.
